data.name: Mijdad
data.gender_notes: Mijdad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mijdad is a name derived from the Arabic word 'mujaddid' which means 'renewer' or 'reviver'. In Islamic history, Mijdad ibn Amr As-Sadusi was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a brave warrior in the Battle of Uhud. This name is often given to boys in the Muslim world as a symbol of courage and loyalty. The name Mijdad carries the meaning “Brave soldier” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mijdad usually hope their child will grow to embody brave soldier and live with faith, good character and purpose.
